steps.name: deploy: the app applied 175_commission_snapshots.sql, 176_ledger_core.sql, 177_ledger_report_source.sql, 178_ledger_reconciliation_runs.sql
settings script: books from 25/11 (Cairo), VAT suspended, commissions settled; posting off, reports on engine
recording the policy before the approvals is refused by the database
a non-admin cannot approve
admin A records the revenue (EAS 48) approval
admin B records the VAT-base approval
an approver cannot record the policy
the finance recorder records policy 2026.11 (gross, VAT suspended, from 25/11) as approved
a non-admin cannot switch posting on
admin switches posting on (verified, logged)
syncing a range that starts before 25/11 is refused (straddles the VAT suspension)
sync from 25/11 posts the books and reconciles clean
10 entries posted, none dated before 25/11 (books start 25/11; no history, no opening balances)
no output or input VAT anywhere in the books (taxes postponed)
the refund reduced revenue (R-1), not the guest receivable
the forfeited 1200 deposit: revenue 1200, owner gets 900 (100% − company 25%) (R-5)
admin switches reports to the ledger (verified, logged)
statements from the stored ledger equal the live calculation (trial balance, P&L)
the reconciliation monitor records a clean run; Data health is clear
the control log names who switched posting and reports on
